The measured evolution mechanism now covers immutable signals and targets, opt-in research providers, reproduction and variant records, isolated single-writer workspaces, fixed benchmark comparison, serialized cycles, recommend-only defaults, and controlled-local canary rollback. Production research providers and cadence, autonomous technique-to-code materialization, real variant mutation, long-running monitoring, and any deployment path remain unconfigured.
